skill.summary: Extract text from PDFs using Google Gemini OCR. Use when extracting text from PDFs, performing OCR on scanned documents, or processing image-based PDFs.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Clarified data and privacy section to explicitly state that full page images/files are sent to Google's API.
- Added note that there are no hidden exfiltration endpoints or other data collection.
- Improved warning for users about using the skill with highly sensitive documents.
